scheme_name: Scheme of Scholarship for Sainik Schools
other_conditions: Must be a student of Sainik School, Goalpara
Must be fluent in English language
Must be a child of Service Personnel (including ex‑servicemen)
benefits_summary: Scholarships of ₹20,000 or ₹10,000 per student depending on family income (below ₹5,000/month or between ₹5,000‑₹8,000/month).
